name: smwmusic-mega-man-x-burnt-out-rhythm-flame-mammoth-remix
title: Mega Man X - Burnt Out Rhythm 🔥 ~ Flame Mammoth (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝙃𝙖 𝙝𝙖 𝙝𝙖. 𝙉𝙤𝙬 𝙞𝙩'𝙨 𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙚 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙢𝙚 𝙩𝙤 𝙨𝙩𝙤𝙢𝙥 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙛𝙪𝙩𝙪𝙧𝙚 𝙞𝙣𝙩𝙤 𝙙𝙪𝙨𝙩! ❞
ㅤ- Flame Mammoth, Mega Man Maverick Hunter X (2005)

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ

Did a chill arrangement of Flame Mammoth's Stage from Mega Man X. I realized I only had one Maverick Stage theme left to arrange from X1 and complete the whole roster. Initially started out working on a fast-paced upbeat arrangement heavily based off the original, but then I decided to scrap it for a slow 'n funky beat instead because it'd be really funny to see if it would actually come out right.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. F Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. E Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
ㅤ4. G Minor (Custom Pitch 3)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7) ← ("MMX1 Overdrive Loud.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("MIDI Cowbell.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15) ← ("THG Orch Hit 24K.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

versions.title: Mega Man X - Burnt Out Rhythm 🔥 ~ Flame Mammoth (Remix)
